verdict.rationale: Ramp MCP lets employees "get policy answers directly from their daily tools." The AI Agents guide lists policy Q&A as a capability, which covers "can I expense this?" before spend. Missing-receipt chasing is documented through an MCP prompt that finds transactions missing receipts and drafts reminders, CLI transactions missing/flag-missing/explain-missing commands, and automated reminders submitted via SMS, Slack or Teams. Missing for 10: any documented conversational explanation of card declines, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy Q&A works.
